title: Plumeform scroll reveal
description: CSS-only entrance on scroll: content fades in, rises 22px and sharpens from a soft blur over its first 220px in the window, staggered 40px per list item. Also a 340ms swap-in class for tab and toggle changes.
notes: uses animation-timeline: view(); browsers without it, and reduced motion, show everything in place
use the wrapper, or put plumeformReveal() and plumeformRevealStyle(step) on your own element
plumeformSwapIn replays when the element's React key changes
